text_block_list.text: I visited a shrine with Ikuno Dictus, who had been in a bit of a slump lately.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...There, all set.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Fufu, what do you think I wished for?

She's someone who takes far more care of her health than most.
If she were to make a wish, it would probably be—
choice_data_list: Isn't it a prayer for good health?
Isn't it a prayer for good health?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Half right.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I made a wish: "May my efforts to stay healthy bear fruit."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In the end, you're the only one
who can take action for your own health.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've finished visiting the shrine...
I should stock up on healthcare products on the way back.

text_block_list.name: Drugstore Clerk
text_block_list.text:
A supporter is worth 1 point, and a hot compress is 5 points.
Now, let me stamp your loyalty card—

text_block_list.name: Drugstore Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Dear customer, your stamp card is full!
Please pick any item you like from this basket~♪

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Th-This is... !?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Holds your hair firmly yet leaves it soft and silky!
It resists rain, wind, mud, and intense sun—famed as the running Umamusume's greatest ally...!

text_block_list.name: Drugstore Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's a new hair treatment!
Please feel free to take one home~.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That hair treatment is guaranteed to sell out.
It's famous for smoothing out stubborn braid kinks, after all.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
To think we'd run into each other
while shopping for healthcare supplies—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, could this mean that
our "actions for health have borne fruit"
right away?

text_block_list.name: Drugstore Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this stamp card...
It expired yesterday...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: N-No way...!

Making a mistake so uncharacteristic of someone
who manages everything so thoroughly left her feeling down...
